name: io.github.stevemilton/agentmarketplace-mcp
description: Discover MCP servers + tools, auto-install into any client, pay for x402 endpoints in USDC.

environmentVariables.name: ARISPAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. ArisPay API key (ap_live_… or an agent-scoped key from `agentmarketplace agent create`). Required only for publish_agent and paid call_agent invocations.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMARKETPLACE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the registry URL. Default: https://api.arispay.app/v1/marketplace
